verdict.rationale: The only first-party automation evidence is a generic marketing line, "Automate tasks and workflows with Trello", which never mentions scheduled or recurring triggers. Power-Up buttons are developer-built, one-off manual triggers, and REST webhooks are developer primitives rather than a recurring schedule. Calendar sync is an adjacent feature that does not run workflows, so nothing evidences a workflow that runs on a schedule or recurring event.

support.subject: As an engineer, I can create a workflow that runs on a schedule or recurring event to handle routine team work
